name: zmodel_light_build_light_weights
description: zModel_Light::BuildLightWeights builds software-path per-vertex lighting weights, commits the selected fog target path, blends the packed fog color, and reports whether lighting/fog work was applied.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel lighting helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel lighting source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x488d60 shows per-vertex active-light validity/range scratch setup, surface normal normalization, angular and distance weight accumulation, single-light or override fog target commit selection, max-weight clamping, 255-scale fog blend, and a zero return when no light or fog override contributes.

The native smoke verifies a full-weight active light normalizes the input normal, commits the light specular fog target, changes the packed color output, and verifies the no-active-light path leaves the packed color unchanged and returns zero.
